(Nasdaq: FSLR) (the “Company”) today announced financial results for the fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 2025. Net sales for the fourth quarter were $1.7 billion, an increase of $0.1 billion from the prior quarter. The increase was primarily driven by an increase in the volume of modules sold in the fourth quarter. Net sales for the full year 2025 were $5.2 billion compared to $4.2 billion in the prior year, driven by a 24% increase in third‑party module volume.
